ownership.quote: MacStadium , the Mac hosting authority and only provider of Mac Pro private cloud infrastructure-as-a-service ("IaaS") around the world, announced today that it received a growth equity investment led by Summit Partners, with participation from Noro-Moseley Partners.

stage.quote: MacStadium... received a growth equity investment led by Summit Partners, with participation from Noro-Moseley Partners.
stage.note: Only priced round found publicly is a May 2017 growth-equity investment led by Summit Partners with Noro-Moseley Partners (amount undisclosed); a 2019 press mention of an expanded $57M credit capacity is debt, not equity. No later equity round or acquisition was found, so the exact current stage label doesn't map cleanly to the fixed list; company appears to remain an independent, growth-equity-backed private company (not bootstrapped, not a subsidiary, not public).

last_round.quote: Summit Partners leads financing round, with participation from Noro-Moseley Partners, to strengthen the company's position as the leading provider of Mac infrastructure for individuals and enterprises.

note: Founded 2012 in Atlanta, GA (per the 2017 Summit Partners release). Growth-equity backed since May 2017 (Summit Partners lead, Noro-Moseley Partners participating); no acquisition, IPO, or later priced equity round was found in the time spent. A 2019 Business Journals piece describes CFO Michael Landreth expanding the company's credit capacity to $57M to fund growth — that is a debt facility, not an equity round, and should not be counted as funding raised. Product line now includes bare hosted Macs plus the Orka macOS VM orchestration platform (sold separately, contact-sales).
